n = int(input())
input_str = input()

import re

regex_pattern = r"\([\w_]*\)"
parts = re.split(regex_pattern, input_str)

max_word_len = 0
for part in parts:
    max_in_part = max([len(s) for s in part.split('_')] + [0])
    if max_in_part > max_word_len:
        max_word_len = max_in_part

pattern = re.compile(regex_pattern)
matches = pattern.findall(input_str)

inside_words_count = 0
for match in matches:
    inside = match[1:-1]
    inside_words_count += len([s for s in inside.split('_') if s])

print(f"{max_word_len} {inside_words_count}")
